definitions.explanation: The sport of jumping or diving into water from a platform or springboard, performing acrobatic movements.
The act of suddenly jumping or diving into something, such as water.
Visiting without an appointment, especially in sales contexts.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{競技|きょうぎ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the Olympic diving competition.

examples.japanese: プールへの{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Diving into the pool is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}で{新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: I acquired new customers through cold calling.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{飛|と}び{込|こ}みの{選手|せんしゅ}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active as a diving athlete.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{台|だい}の{高|たか}さは10メートルだ。
examples.english: The diving platform is 10 meters high.

examples.japanese: シンクロナイズド{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{息|いき}を{合|あ}わせるのが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Synchronized diving is difficult to coordinate.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}みの{演技|えんぎ}で{高得点|こうとくてん}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: She scored high marks in her diving performance.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}への{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Jumping into the river is dangerous.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}への{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{爽快|そうかい}だった。
examples.english: Diving into the sea was refreshing.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}からの{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{禁止|きんし}です。
{岩場|いわば}からの{飛|と}び{込|こ}みを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed jumping in from the rocky area.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{客|きゃく}でも{歓迎|かんげい}します。
{飛|と}び{込|こ}みで{面接|めんせつ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I went for an interview without an appointment.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}みの{訪問|ほうもん}{販売|はんばい}は{嫌|きら}われることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Door-to-door sales without appointments are often disliked.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}みで{旅館|りょかん}に{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at an inn without a reservation.

notes:
DIVING TYPES:
・{高|た}か{飛|と}び{込|こ}み (platform diving - 10m platform)
・{飛板飛|とびいたと}び{込|こ}み (springboard diving)
・シンクロナイズド{飛|と}び{込|こ}み (synchronized diving)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{台|だい} (diving platform/board)
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう} (cold calling/canvassing)
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{客|きゃく} (walk-in customer)

VERB FORM:
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}む (to dive in, to jump into)

CAUTION: At many Japanese pools, {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし} (no diving) signs are posted for safety reasons.
